entries.candidate: Equinix SV18, 127 Great Oaks Blvd, San Jose (Great Oaks South Data Center campus; county parcel 706-02-060)
entries.reason: The Energy Commission notice of determination received 7 May 2026 (SCH 2020100431, captured here) places SV18 at 127 Great Oaks Boulevard, one of the three Great Oaks South buildings (SV12 at 123, SV19 at 131), which corrects the third-party association with 123 Great Oaks Blvd noted in the q3-us-reits-p3 / sixty-eighth hold. This fragment adds the campus as a new site through its SV12x data-hall fit-out permits, and a site new in an update can take only one project, so SV18 is not added now. The q3-us-reits-p3 hold rests on an Equinix product manager's community post of 5 August 2026 ('now open'), not re-captured here. The City of San Jose permit lists of 26 October 2026 also carry 2026-134965-CI 'EQUINIX (BE 100%) DATA CENTER FIT OUT' (8,430 sq ft, issued 3 September 2026, active) at 127 Great Oaks Bl on APN 706-02-060.
entries.reopen_condition: Once curated:equinix-great-oaks-south-data-center-campus-san-jose is published, add SV18 as a project on that site reusing its campus locator, either as operational from a captured in-window Equinix statement (the 5 August post leaves the 85-day window on about 29 October 2026; Equinix's third-quarter 2026 results are a later option) or as permitted from permit 2026-134965-CI (issued 3 September 2026, in window until about 27 November 2026), scoped to that fit-out.

entries.candidate: Flexential Hillsboro 6 (planned data center at the Hillsboro 1 site, 3935 NE Aloclek Place, Hillsboro, Washington County, Oregon)
entries.reason: Flexential's 18 August 2026 release (local prn-flexential-800m-20260818.html) says that besides the 36 MW Portland-Hillsboro facility under construction (Hillsboro 5, already in the Atlas) 'Also planned are another 36 MW facility in Portland-Hillsboro'. The facility is not named; Flexential's 4 September 2025 release (local prn-flexential-hillsboro-property-20250904.html) describes Hillsboro 6 as a 350,000 sq ft, 27 MW data center on a parcel 'across from' Hillsboro 1 at 3935 NE Aloclek Place, and the 28 May 2026 release says Flexential bought 'additional property on that site'. The 36 MW versus 27 MW difference leaves the identity of the planned facility inferential, and the Hillsboro 6 parcel is not pinned: Metro's public taxlot layer has no owners, and the only nearby taxlot with a 2025 sale is the 3935 NE Aloclek Dr taxlot itself (1N223DD05100, 14.29 acres, sale August 2025), not a parcel across the street. A new site here would be about 3.9 km south-east of the Atlas's Flexential Starr campus.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Flexential or City of Hillsboro record that names Hillsboro 6 and gives its address or taxlot (or Flexential's own page naming the planned Portland-Hillsboro 36 MW facility as Hillsboro 6), while the 18 August 2026 release stays within 85 days (until 11 November 2026) or with a newer record.
